### God of the Impossible - Homeword - June 11
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/god-of-the-impossible-homeword-june-11.html
Passage: Luke 1:37
Points:
- Despite aerodynamic arguments claiming bumblebees should not fly, they do so daily by God's design.
- Scripture repeatedly records God intervening in history to accomplish what is humanly impossible.
- Human beings often evaluate life by natural limits and forget that God remains with them.
- Facing seemingly overwhelming difficulties offers an invitation to trust God for miraculous provision.

### Streams in the Desert - May 29
Author: Mrs. Charles Cowman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/desert/streams-in-the-desert-may-29-1399099.html
Passage: Luke 1:37
Points:
- Delicate Alpine flowers generate warmth beneath the snow, breaking through ice to blossom.
- Nature illustrates how God takes delight in bringing beauty and life out of impossible settings.
- Relying entirely on earthly hope and human ability often hinders faith in divine action.
- Believers are called to look beyond accumulated difficulties and trust the God of the impossible.
